SuperSLM -- vendored source dependency

Tag:    v1.15.0
Commit: 165962acafe901753dfe37153d7116b132a18b5a
Base release commit: 165962acafe901753dfe37153d7116b132a18b5a
Release status: published release v1.15.0
Source repository: the upstream SuperSLM repository (not this repository)

The Tag line names the release and the Commit line the commit the tag points to. The pin moves from v1.13.1
to v1.15.0 across two releases. 1.14.0 adds frozen-prefix save and restore on the CPU (sslm_prefix_save,
sslm_prefix_restore, the SPX1 blob and status SSLM_RESTORE_PRODUCER_MISMATCH, ordinal 30), and refuses at map
time a model whose schema names collide under FNV-1a 64 or hash to zero (the certified models still map).
1.15.0 speeds up schema-bound CPU decode: the masked finish (always on, tokens unchanged), and two opt-in verbs,
sslm_seq_forced_tokens and sslm_seq_jump_forward, with the canonical and exact jump-forward modes. The public
ABI is 1.13.1's plus four C verbs, one status, one enum (sslm_jump_mode) and one struct (sslm_jump_options); no
existing declaration, struct layout, status ordinal or save format changes. Release notes:
docs/releases/1.14.0.md and docs/releases/1.15.0.md.

The distribution has 1575 files, excluding .github/ and this vendoring metadata. Each is byte-identical
to git show 165962acafe901753dfe37153d7116b132a18b5a:<path>, except the five existing consumer-witness repairs
listed below (upstream did not change those five files between v1.13.1 and v1.15.0).

Raw blobs were read through git ls-tree and git cat-file --batch. The complete SHA-256 manifest
records every file and is checked by ci/check_vendored_tree_matches_manifest.py. The five local
witness/tool adaptations to SuperSLMFinishHook::Make are retained unchanged:
route_p_hook_witness.cpp, route_p_run_count.cpp, run_route_p_hook_witness.sh, run_merge_acceptance.sh,
and shim/CoreMinimal.h under tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/. Their hashes remain explicit. The
coherence check (.github/scripts/check_vendored_against_tag.py) reads these Repaired lines: a listed
file may differ from the tag, must still be present, and must actually differ; any other difference fails.
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/route_p_hook_witness.cpp
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/route_p_run_count.cpp
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/run_route_p_hook_witness.sh
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/run_merge_acceptance.sh
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/shim/CoreMinimal.h

History: v1.15.0 was vendored from v1.13.1 on 2026-10-24, skipping a v1.14.0 pin on develop; the 1.14.0
and 1.15.0 candidates were vendored on the dogfood branch for validation first. v1.13.1 was vendored on
2026-10-19, and v1.13.0 from v1.11.0 on 2026-10-15. No library source or existing test is removed. Earlier
source pins and the initial v1.2.0 import are retained in Git history.

v1.14.0 added one library source, in SUPERSLM_CORE_SOURCES, so the wrapper set gains one unguarded wrapper:
- src/spx1_format.cpp (with its private header src/spx1_format.h), the SPX1 prefix-blob reader and writer:
  Private/Vendored/SuperSLMVendored_spx1_format.cpp.
The other new files are headers: include/superslm/sslm_version.h (the producer version SPX1 records),
src/detail/anti_lm_update.h and src/tokenizer_tables.h (1.15.0's all-or-nothing anti-LM history update and the
forced-next table). The superslm_gpu source list is unchanged. The GPU prefix verbs (sslm_gpu_prefix_save,
sslm_gpu_prefix_restore) are exported but stay unreleased until 1.16.0; this plugin leaves
SUPERSLM_WITH_GPU_PREFIX_SAVE at its default 0, so it calls neither.

What changed in this plugin for the pin: SuperSLMUnreal.Build.cs turns on SUPERSLM_WITH_PREFIX_CACHE (the
prefix cache over sslm_prefix_save/restore) and SUPERSLM_WITH_SCHEMA_JUMP_FORWARD (skip-ahead over
sslm_seq_jump_forward); SuperSLMGpuStatusMapping.h maps SSLM_RESTORE_PRODUCER_MISMATCH; and the CI pins.
See CHANGELOG.md (1.3.0).

Saves: the CPU sequence save is still SSB5 for every sequence this plugin makes and the GPU save is still
SLM5, both byte-equal to v1.13.1's under every setting except canonical skip-ahead, which changes the tokens.
As at every pin, the Layer-1 tag in the save wrapper changes, so a save taken at the v1.13.1 pin is refused
Layer1Mismatch. An SPX1 prefix blob records its producer, so a cached prefix from another engine version is
refused SSLM_RESTORE_PRODUCER_MISMATCH and rebuilt by prefill (a cache miss, not an error).

**The first vendoring pass at v1.2.0 (2026-08-22) was corrected the same day**: `git archive`
on Windows applies `.gitattributes`' `text`/`eol=crlf`
line-ending rules exactly as a normal checkout would, so every `*.cpp`/`*.h`/`*.md`/etc. file
(marked `text`, tool-native on checkout) came out CRLF-converted -- 357 of 526 files differed
from the tag by line endings only, content unaffected. `git show <tag>:<path>` does not apply
this conversion -- it returns the raw blob -- so every re-vendoring since, including this one,
reads every file that way instead of via `git archive`.

This plugin never consumes a prebuilt SuperSLM binary. It builds this tree from source with the
engine's own toolchain, which is why
the full CMake project -- including its test and tool executables' source, not only include/
and the library sources -- is vendored: CMakeLists.txt declares those targets unconditionally
at configure time, and configure fails if their sources are absent.

Do not hand-edit Layer 1 engine files under this directory. A correction to SuperSLM is made upstream and
this tree is re-vendored at the new pin. The witness repairs above are tracked local exceptions.
`VENDORED_MANIFEST.sha256` records this tree's current per-file hashes, checked by
`ci/tests/test_vendored_tree_checks_run_in_ci.py` against the COMMITTED tree at every `ci/tests`
run -- an unrecorded edit that alters any file's content fails that check. (`ci/check_vendored_tree_matches_manifest.py` and
`ci/check_vendored_wrappers_complete.py` are the checkers; `ci/tests` runs them, and the
repository's coherence-checks workflow runs them too.)
